thread:
jess: FYI I pulled 4 nodes from g2-slot7 that kept throwing intermittent Xid+PCIe reset signatures. Want to lock down a stricter pre-return soak/handoff before we put them back in pool. Proposed checklist below — please weigh in.

omar: +1 on stricter. Can we centralize logs so bench folks don't chase different mounts? Suggest a single artifacts tarball per run (hwmon, dmesg, nvidia-smi -q, pci.ids).

li: Agree. Also add a deterministic repro workload (small seq len chat traffic + long context attention) — that's what triggered the soft-fail in prod.

jess: Good call. Draft workflow: 1) Quarantine tag QB-2026-03-18 on nodes; 2) 48h continuous soak with scheduled thermal cycles (fan profiles: 30% -> 100% -> idle) every 4h; 3) ECC scrubbing + memtester passes; 4) PCIe-reset flood test; 5) application repro harness for 6h; 6) final 12h stability window.

carmen: Can you paste the commands we'll run? I'll hand off to bench.

jess: Sure — bench script (simplified):
```bash
# start artifact capture
soakctl start --node $NODE --tag QB-2026-03-18 --collect hwmon,dmesg,nvidia,pcie
# thermal cycle mode
soakctl run --mode thermal-cycle --cycles 12 --interval 4h \n  --fan-profiles "30,100,0" --memtest memtester:2G:5 \n  --pci-fuzz on --app-harness /opt/repro/chat-longseq --harness-duration 6h
# after soak, run 12h idle stability check
soakctl run --mode idle-stability --duration 12h
soakctl stop --node $NODE --upload /mnt/artifacts/$NODE-qb.tar.gz
```

omar: Add `--collect /var/log/audit.log` and kernel oops extractor. Also make sure bench mounts have enough disk (at least 10G per node) for artifacts.

infra-bot: deploy-bench started soak run on g2-slot7-node03 (job id 5127)

jess: Thanks. For triage rules: if Xid 79 or repeated PCIe AER entries >3 in 1h, escalate to hardware replace. If soft Xid 13/31 + transient mem errors less than 5 over 48h, mark for extended soak. Anything else?

li: Capture nv_peer_mem and PCIe AER counters before and after. Those deltas helped us last time. Also dump BAR mapping once per boot.

carmen: We should add an explicit 'driver pin' step: lock GPU driver to the candidate release used in prod to rule out driver regressions.

jess: Good — add driver pin + kernel version as metadata in the artifact manifest. I'll update bench playbook.

sre-oncall: Quick note on scheduling: dedicate 2 nodes/day from the pool to avoid exhausting spare capacity. If tests flag replacement, auto-schedule replacement with procurement tag RB-GPU-REPL.

omar: One more ops nicety — a short triage template in the artifact tar: cause hypothesis, repro steps, key diffs, decision (return/replace/extend). Makes handoffs fast.

jess: Agreed. I'll upload the updated checklist and template to /docs/eng-infra/gpu-quarantine.md and ping bench.

infra-bot: job 5127 completed on g2-slot7-node03: artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-qa/qb/1898765432-node03.tar.gz

jess: Nice. Who can run the first 48h soak summary on Monday?

omar: I can take Monday morning. Will run the parser and post a short triage note.

li: I'll verify repro harness logs and check ECC counters.

carmen: Bench will keep nodes in quarantine until we have 'return' signoff. :white_check_mark:

jess: Perfect. Final decision criteria we agreed: (a) no Xid 79 / PCIe AER spikes for 48h + stable nv_peer_mem deltas => return; (b) repeated hardware AER/Xid 79 => immediate replace; (c) borderline => extend soak 72h + escalate to hwEng for deep bench.

sre-oncall: Logged schedule in ops calendar and bumped spare pool threshold to 3 GPUs for the week.

jess: Thanks team. I'll post the updated checklist later today and close the loop here.
